findings.text: follow-on: appends one JSON line to a .jsonl under the crew home, a shape the picker package already implements in outcomes.record_picker_hold at reckon/crew/picker/outcomes.py:87 with flock and fsync; the best-effort, bounded contract here genuinely differs from that recorder's durable contract, so the duplication is of the low-level append mechanism rather than of the holds recorder itself and is worth a shared helper.

follow-on: estimate_ms is timed around only math.ceil(len(rendered)/4), so the field the goal calls the estimated-context figure measures a length division rather than that stage's real cost, which can misattribute a slow pick when read from the line.
